methodology.window_policy: arbitrary dashboard defaults (20/60/21/63/30/90/252/365) — not a registered research design
methodology.returns: simple daily P_t/P_{t-1}-1 on auto-adjusted Close (NaNs dropped) on each name's native series
methodology.corr_window: last 60 overlapping dates with all 9 names non-null on ALIGNED-PANEL pct_change (not native-series RV)
methodology.corr_vs_fomc: corr.end 2026-09-15 is BEFORE FOMC 2026-09-16; no allocation implication
methodology.mdd: min peak-to-trough over lookback bars (252 equity / 365 crypto)
methodology.rel_returns: simple difference name total return minus benchmark total return — NOT alpha, NOT beta-adjusted
methodology.ret_bars: equities 21/63 price steps; crypto 30/90 price steps; do not label as calendar months
methodology.ytd: first native bar with date >= 2026-01-01 through asof; post-selection descriptive only
methodology.hl: NOT fetched by this script; stale lab snapshot is appendix-only (HTTP 429 on live refresh)
